rows.text: walks the singly linked list headed by qword `0215FD58` (next pointer at `+0x8`) for a node whose dword `+0x14` equals `ecx`, and when none is found walks the list headed by qword `0215FD78` the same way, returning when neither holds one; on a match it decrements the node's word `+0x1C` and, when the result is at most 0 (signed) and byte `+0x19` AND 3 is non-zero, stores word 0 there

resolves dword `[rcx]` through `0020E600` and returns when the result is null; otherwise resolves it again and, only when byte `+0x6` of that result is non-zero, stores the low word of `edx` to word `rcx+0x60`

resolves dword `[rcx]` through `0020E600`, then scans byte `rcx+0x4` entries of the result starting at its `+0x2A` with stride 0x30, comparing each entry's zero-extended word shifted right by 4 with `edx`; returns the index of the first match, or 0xFFF when none matches (including when the count is 0)
stores word 0 at `rcx+0xC`, word 1 at `rcx+0x2` and byte 1 at `[rcx]`
does nothing when byte `[rcx]` is 0; otherwise copies dword `rcx+0x10` to `+0x18` and dword `+0x14` to `+0x1C`, stores byte 0 at `[rcx]` and stores the dword `0x3F800000` at `+0xC`
does nothing when byte `[rcx]` is non-zero; otherwise copies dword `rcx+0x10` to `+0x18` and dword `+0x14` to `+0x1C`, stores the dword 0x101 at `[rcx]` and the dword `0x3F800000` at `+0xC`
ANDs byte `rcx+0x9` with `0xF` and stores byte 0 at `rcx+0x8`

ANDs byte `rcx+0x9` with `0x3F`; when `edx` is 0 it then ORs `0x40` into that byte and stores byte 0 at `+0x8`; otherwise it returns when the byte AND `0x30` is 0, else stores the byte AND `0xDF` OR `0x10` back and, when that value is below 0x40 (unsigned) and byte `+0x8` is 0, stores qword 8 at `+0x10`, word 1 at `+0xA` and byte 1 at `+0x8`, returning without those stores otherwise

ANDs byte `rcx+0x1` with `0xF`; then, only when byte `[rcx]` is non-zero, copies dword `+0x10` to `+0x88` and dword `+0x4C` to `+0x8C`, stores byte 0 at `[rcx]` and stores the dword `0x3F800000` at `+0xC`
reads byte `rcx+0x34` and, only when its bit 0 is clear, stores it back with bit 0 set and stores word 0 at `+0x30`

notes: 0x3F800000 in 00471380/004715D0/005175C0 is an immediate (the bit pattern of 1.0f), not a decoded constant, so it is given as the dword. 004719A0: the AND is the entry instruction, so the only anchor is the byte store. 00471B20: after the AND 0x3F and AND 0xDF/OR 0x10 the value can never reach 0x40, so the 'below 0x40' test always passes; stated literally. 002EB810: rax (the matched node or the null end of the list) is left in the return register on every path; no caller use is asserted. 0040DB00: also entered from 003E1210 + 0x5B.
